verdict.rationale: Acting as an OAuth provider is a fair question for an auth service, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Supabase Auth consuming external OAuth/OIDC providers, plus a JWKS URL and custom access-token claims. Nothing shows it issuing tokens to registered third-party clients, and a community user says they are building this IdP capability themselves on top of Supabase.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn my own application into an OAuth provider that issues tokens to third-party clients ("Sign in with my app")
